name: SEI
summary: Interview an existing software project, map user flows, find risk candidates, and open a plain-language local dashboard.
summary_ko: 기존 프로젝트를 인터뷰하고 사용자 흐름과 위험 후보를 쉬운 로컬 화면으로 보여줍니다.

trigger_examples.text: 이 프로젝트에 SEI를 설치하고 인터뷰부터 시작해줘
코드 버그뿐 아니라 사용자 흐름과 인지 부채까지 점검해줘
비개발자도 보는 로컬 품질 대시보드를 열어줘
Attach SEI to this local project and interview me first.
Map the user journeys and inspect hidden fallback risks.
Open a plain-language local assurance dashboard.

anti_triggers.text: Upload the private source tree to a hosted scanner.
Guarantee that this repository has no bugs.

approval_requirements: Ask before enabling an LLM or network call.
Ask before replacing existing Git hooks.
Never infer code mutation or deployment authority from inspection.
known_failure_cases: Static inspection cannot prove runtime or user outcomes.
Large repositories may reach the bounded scan budget.
A configured LLM can propose hypotheses but cannot confirm defects.
routing_status_reason: Public alpha; deterministic inspection still requires independent runtime and user-outcome evidence.
